svg.title: Reported Credit Limit Ladders
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-credit-limit-ladders; chapter number: 4; title: Reported Credit Limit Ladders; subtitle: Starting limit to reported peak across four practitioner cases; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: $1K to $66K reported across four ladders; buckets: label: Navy Federal limit climb; low: 10000; high: 66000; notes: Jan 2020 to Feb 2024 in roughly $8K steps, requests spaced 190-195 days (Cal Barton).; label: Capital One increase ladder; low: 1000; high: 30800; notes: Three +$100 bumps, then +$2,500, +$7,000 and +$20K; 6 months called the sweet spot (Cal Barton).; label: Navy Federal deposit seasoning; low: 2000; high: 18000; notes: $250 opening deposit plus $500 biweekly direct deposit preceded the jump (Stephen Smith).; label: Chase Sapphire reallocation; low: 10000; high: 25000; notes: Cutting a Sapphire from $25K to $10K opened room for a $30K Ink Business Preferred (Naam Wynn).; caption: Limits follow stated income and heavy, cleanly repaid usage; Chase caps total exposure near 50% of income and Amex near 35%.; assumptions note: Cycle one to three times a month with each charge under 70% of the line; after a denial wait three months on a soft pull or six on a hard pull (Colin Matthew, Stephen Smith).; note: Sources - Cal Barton, Stephen Smith, Naam Wynn, Colin Matthew.
